Commentary.Commentary: The spinners got a little grip from the surface but the Sri Lankans tackled them smartly. A breezy cameo from Angelo Mathews provided the momentum in the later stages of the innings. Upul Tharanga was patient and scored a good half century but couldn't accelerate as much as he would have liked in the slog overs. Tendai Chatara was the pick of the bowlers as he kept the batsmen guessing with his variations and picked up two wickets. The visitors have a stiff task ahead of them and will need to play out of their skins to pull this chase off. Join us shortly for the chase.

Sri Lanka have posted a strong total on the board courtesy some fluent strokeplay. They would have looked to finish with a bit more flourish but will be happy with their effort. Zimbabwe began well as they bowled tight channels and struck early. However, Gunathilaka and Mendis kept the scoreboard ticking and stitched a well-paced 117-run stand. They played some eye-catching shots and entertained the crowd.

NOT OUT! Full ball down the leg side, Tharanga goes for the flick but misses and the keeper goes up but the umpire is not interested and signals a wide. After thinking for a while Zimbabwe decide to review. The umpire goes upstairs to check. The ball misses the bat and brushes the pad and it remains not out. The umpire signals for the end of the over as the review shows that the ball had brushed the pads and the wide has been overturned. A smart review by them, it does not get them a wicket but saves a run. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 316/5.

Back of a length ball outside off, Mendis lets it through to the keeper.
Short ball outside off, Mendis defends it off the back foot.

In the air... but safe! Good length on off, Gunathilaka tries to go big but gets it off the splice of the bat. The ball lobs just over extra cover and there are three men after it but it lands safe. The batsmen run a single.
Length outside off, Gunathilaka guides it through backward point for a couple.

BIG APPEAL! Full on leg stump, Mendis goes for the flick but misses and is struck on the pads. The bowler appeals but the umpire gives it not out. Might be slipping down leg. The ball rolls on the leg side and the batsmen take a leg bye.
Length on off, the batsman defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! DISPATCHED! Short and on the body. Gunathilaka comes inside the line and hits it through square leg for a boundary. That raced away to the fence. Second boundary of the over.
BEATEN! Good comeback by the bowler. Good length delivery angling away, the batsman pokes at it and gets beaten.
FOUR! WOW! Full ball outside off, Gunathilaka stands tall and hits it over mid off for a boundary. That made a good sound of the bat.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and swinging away, Mendis tries to drive but gets an outside edge to point. The fielder misfields and concedes a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.

Was there an edge? Full and wide outside off, the batsman slashes at it but misses. The keeper makes a loud appeal but is not supported by the bowler. The umpire shakes his head and gives it not out. Cremer asks the keeper and they opt not to review. The replays show there was clear daylight between bat and ball.
Short ball on middle, Mendis tucks it on the leg side for a run.
On a fuller length outside off, Gunathilaka guides it down to third man for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Two wides! Full and angling down the leg side, Mendis tries to flick it but misses. The keeper fumbles and concedes an extra as well.
Kusal Mendis comes out to bat. He is a promising cricketer and will look to stamp his authority today. Two slips in place.

OUT! Chatara strikes! This is his 50th ODI wicket. He gets the dangerman Dickwella. A soft dismissal there. A tad fuller outside off, Dickwella gets his front leg out of the way and plays it away from his body. Ends up hitting it straight to Ryan Burl at short cover who takes a good catch. Sri Lanka lose their first. Zimbabwe have bowled well till now.
Fullish outside off, Dickwella square drives it to third man for a run.
Strays on the pads, Dickwella flicks it through square leg for a couple.
FOUR! A tad short outside off, Dickwella guides it between point and third man and the ball races away to the fence. That was beautifully timed.
Full and on off, Dickwella lofts it over mid on but does not get it off the middle of the bat. The fielder runs and stops the ball before the boundary. The batsmen run two.
Seam up delivery, outside off, Dickwella pokes at it and gets beaten.
Slower ball on off, Dickwella drives it to covers.
FOUR! LOVELY SHOT! Full and outside off, Gunathilaka leans into it and drives it through the cover region for a boundary. Their first of the day.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Beaten again. Lands it on a length, nips away after pitching. Gunathilaka tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten.
Danushka stays back to this one and pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! Back of a length ball on middle, angles across. Gunathilaka pokes at it and gets beaten. Lovely ball there.
Short and wide outside off, the batsman goes to cut but gets beaten.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full outside off, Dickwella goes for the heave on the leg side but misses.

NOT OUT! A tad fuller on leg, Gunathilaka pushes it to mid on and sets off for a run. The fielder has a shy at the non-striker's end and hits. The umpire goes upstairs to check and the replays show the batsman has made his ground. A single taken.
There is a referral upstairs for a run out appeal at the non-striker's end.
Short and a little bit of width on offer, Dickwella runs it down to third man for a run. He is off the mark.
Doles it on a length on off, Dickwella defends it off the front foot.
Back of a length on middle, Dickwella defends it off the back foot.
Donald Tiripano will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Full on off, the batsman drives it to mid off. Good first over by Chatara.
A tad fuller on off, Gunathilaka plays it off the front foot.
Lands it on a length on middle, Gunathilaka tries to flick it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full and wide outside off, Gunathilaka lets it through to the keeper.
Good length ball outside off, shaping back in a little. The batsman does not bother to play at it.
Starts off on a length outside off. Dickwella lets the ball through. The keeper fumbles and the batsmen run through for a bye.

The players are out for their respective National Anthems. After the completion, we are ready to get underway. Niroshan Dickwella and Danushka Gunathilaka will open the batting for Sri Lanka. Tendai Chatara to start off the proceedings with the ball. Two slips in place. Here we go...

Zimbabwe skipper, Graeme Cremer says they would have batted as well. Reckons that it is a good track and it will slow down a bit in the afternoon but will spin throughout. Mentions that they want to take it game by game and start well. Opines that there is some inexperience in the Sri Lankan side and they will look to take advantage of that but also adds that they have some world class players.

Sri Lanka skipper, Angelo Mathews says they will bat first. He feels it looks to be a good wicket. He mentions they want to take one game at a time and don't want to get complacent. Admits they have not played a lot of games here and does not know what would be a good score. Opines that they would like to get as many runs as possible. Informs Lasith Malinga is ready to go.
Toss - Sri Lanka win the toss and opt to bat.

Russel Arnold doing the pitch report says that it is a very good track, nice and dry. Mentions that it is a lot harder than what he has seen in Test cricket. Feels that the pitch will slow down as the game progresses and the spinners will come into play. Alistair Campbell ends by saying that the side winning the toss will like to bat first.

Hello and a warm welcome to the 1st of the 5-match ODI series between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe. The first game will be played at Galle International Stadium. It is a good opportunity for the hosts to test some of the upcoming talented players. Sri Lanka will fancy themselves and Angelo Mathews will want all his teammates to step up. Zimbabwe on the other hand will have to pull up their socks and play some extraordinary cricket to have a chance in this series. The home side are overwhelming favorites, but as we all know, cricket is a funny game. Stay tuned for the toss and more updates.
